context_for_next_testing_agent: User-linking feature for submissions is FULLY WORKING. Key implementation details: 1) POST /api/inquiries (line 1995-2005) uses verify_user_token dependency and stores user_id/user_email in document. 2) POST /api/sample-requests/upload (line 2016-2081) uses verify_user_token dependency and stores user_id/user_email. 3) Both endpoints return 401 without valid token. 4) Frontend SampleRequestModal (line 469) and InquiryModal (line 783) both receive userData and userToken props. 5) Both modals have useEffect hooks that auto-fill company_name, contact_name (first_name + last_name), and email from userData when modal opens. 6) Both modals send Authorization header with userToken when submitting. Test files: /app/backend/tests/test_user_linked_submissions.py has comprehensive API tests.
